Froakie

Water

Kalos · Generation 6

Froakie is a Water-type Bubble Frog Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 7 kg. It evolves into Frogadier. Its highest base stat is Speed (71), with a base stat total of 314.
